facts: The public tourism listing identifies the Gujeju branch as a tax-refund shop selling clothing and footwear at 41 Jungang-ro, Jeju-si.
The listing gives indoor retail hours of 10:00-21:00 daily, holiday closure on Lunar New Year and Chuseok, and states that parking is unavailable.
Shinwon's sustainability report lists BESTIBELLI among its fashion brands, launched as a women's clothing brand in 1990.
The operator describes itself as a fashion company with a global network and exports, so the brand is not a Jeju-origin local business.
